Instructional Designer, Learning & Development
Northwind Health Partners — Remote (U.S.)

Who we are
Northwind Health Partners provides home health services in 14 states. Our L&D team trains more than 3,000 caregivers a year.

What you'll do
- Design and build e-learning courses for caregivers and office staff
- Work with subject matter experts to turn policies into clear training
- Manage course enrollment and reporting in our LMS (Cornerstone)
- Measure whether training changes on-the-job behavior

What we're looking for
- 2+ years of experience designing e-learning or online training
- Proficiency in Articulate Storyline and Rise
- Experience administering a learning management system
- Experience working with subject matter experts
- Bachelor's degree in education, instructional design, or a related field

Nice to have
- Master's degree in instructional design, curriculum, or adult learning
- Experience in healthcare or home health

Compensation: $68,000–$78,000. Full benefits, remote work stipend, 20 days PTO.

Northwind is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. To apply, send your resume and a portfolio link.
